title: Single scalar-extension factorization of relative completed constant realization
statement: Let g:Y\to X be a scheme morphism, A a commutative ring, and d an adic coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Choose phi and beta with the evaluation and projection equations of [def-weil-pbc-completed-constant-realization-data]. Write c for completedConstantRealization on Y followed by restriction along beta and the inverse image of the inverse completed coefficient comparison, exactly as in the parent statement. Assume c is additive and preserves finite limits and finite colimits. Let a_g be constantAdicFiniteRealization and let s_g be the inverse image under g of the limit lift of constantAdicFiniteCone [def-weil-pbc-constant-adic-finite-diagram-data], a map from the inverse image of the constant algebraic completion ring to the inverse image of the completed continuous coefficient ring. There is a natural isomorphism c.mapDerivedCategory \simeq a_g followed by pbcDerivedExtend(s_g). This is a comparison at the completed coefficient ring; it asserts no finite quotient comparison or transition compatibility.

source.place: Tags 06YY (lemma-derived-base-change), 06YU (definition-derived-tor), and 0D6D (lemma-derived-pullback-composition); single scalar computation in step 1 of the parent comparison

proof.text: The given beta agrees with the profinite coefficient inverse-image isomorphism by its equations on every limit projection. The canonical inverse image of a constant ring is also an isomorphism. The limit lift of constantAdicFiniteCone followed by the inverse completed comparison has the stated evaluation components. Apply inverse image and use the evaluation equations and naturality of constant-section inverse image to obtain the coefficient square.

Set C to the algebraic completion and J to the extended ideal in C. The Noetherian completion quotient isomorphisms identify the J-power quotient tower with the original tower. Transport the evaluation equations through this identification. Flatness of the completed constant algebra then makes extension along phi exact. Its universal left derived functor is consequently isomorphic to its exact derived-category functor.

The natural comparison for ordinary inverse images of constant module sheaves, together with the adjunction identification of identity-coefficient module pullback with module inverse image, gives the constant-module comparison on derived categories. The coefficient square identifies the two derived scalar-extension functors: restriction along its horizontal coefficient isomorphisms gives equivalences, and uniqueness of left adjoints to the composite restriction functors supplies the scalar comparison. Combine these isomorphisms with exact-functor composition, the exactness of extension along phi, and the restriction-composition isomorphism. This proves the required natural isomorphism for all unbounded complexes.

lean.statement:
theorem completed_constant_derived_scalar_factorization
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (φ : adicLisseConstantRing Y (AdicCompletion d.ideal A) ⟶
      adicLisseCompletedRing Y d.ideal)
    (hφ : ∀ n : ℕ, φ ≫ limit.π (adicLisseRingSystem Y d.ideal) (op n) =
      (constantSheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).map
        (CommRingCat.ofHom (AdicCompletion.evalₐ d.ideal (n + 1)).toRingHom))
    (β : (adicTowerInverseImage g).obj (adicLisseCompletedRing X d.ideal) ⟶
      adicLisseCompletedRing Y d.ideal)
    (hβ : ∀ n : ℕ, β ≫ limit.π (adicLisseRingSystem Y d.ideal) (op n) =
      (adicTowerInverseImage g).map (limit.π (adicLisseRingSystem X d.ideal) (op n)) ≫
        proEtaleConstantInverseImageMap g CommRingCat.{u + 1}
          (CommRingCat.of (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1)))) :
    let c := completedConstantRealization Y d.ideal φ ⋙ pbcRestrict β ⋙
      pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage g).map (pbcCompletedComparison X d).inv)
    ∀ (hc : c.Additive) (hlim : PreservesFiniteLimits c)
      (hcolim : PreservesFiniteColimits c),
      letI := hc
      letI := hlim
      letI := hcolim
      Nonempty (c.mapDerivedCategory ≅ constantAdicFiniteRealization g d ⋙
        pbcDerivedExtend ((adicTowerInverseImage g).map
          (limit.lift (pbcAdicRings X d) (constantAdicFiniteCone X d))))
